qualifier: with wax and ether lipid synthesis
name: Very-long-chain acyl-CoA, wax and ether lipid biosynthesis
rationale: All members synthesise long/very-long-chain acyl-CoAs or their wax and ether-lipid (plasmalogen) products, separating the theme from peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation confusables and from the elongation confusable that adds linoleic/linolenic metabolism but lacks wax and plasmalogen synthesis.

qualifier: TAK1-driven JNK/p38 activation to AP-1 with MAPK feedback inactivation
name: JNK/p38 activation to AP-1 with MAPK feedback inactivation
rationale: Members cover TAK1-mediated JNK/p38 activation, AP-1 activation and negative feedback that inactivates ERK/MAPK signaling; confusables lack the AP-1 and ERK-inactivation/feedback members or are phosphatase-only or TNF/growth-factor oriented.

qualifier: progenitor division, neuronal migration and cortical layering
name: Brain progenitor division, neuronal migration and cortical layering
rationale: Members span forebrain, midbrain and cerebellar neural progenitor division, radial glia, neuronal migration and cortical/cerebellar layer formation, unlike confusables centred on pituitary/forebrain morphogenesis, reelin-dendrite signaling, dopaminergic differentiation or spinal cord patterning.

name: Common gamma-chain cytokine signaling in T and NK cells
rationale: Members are IL-2, IL-7, IL-9, IL-15 and IL-21 signaling and their T/NK cell outcomes, distinguishing the theme from confusables dominated by IL-6/gp130, IL-10/IL-12 family and IL-3/IL-5 cytokines.

qualifier: at the leading edge for protrusion and motility
name: Leading-edge actin remodeling for protrusion and cell motility
rationale: Members concern actin polymerization, severing, capping, crosslinking and protrusions (lamellipodia, ruffles, podosomes, pseudopodia, macropinocytosis) driving motility, whereas confusables are Rho-family GTPase cycles or filopodial/synaptic actin organization.

name: Organelle lumen acidification and Na+/K+/H+ gradient maintenance
rationale: Members cover V-ATPase acidification of lysosomes, endosomes, Golgi and synaptic vesicles together with Na+/H+ exchangers and Na+/K+ P-type ATPase homeostasis, distinguishing the theme from confusables on phospholipid scrambling, phosphate/bicarbonate or anion transport, and phagosome acidification.

name: Serotonin biosynthesis, secretion and reuptake
rationale: All members concern serotonin synthesis, release and uptake, while confusables cover monoamine oxidative catabolism, catecholamine synthesis/transport or serotonin receptor signaling.

name: Myeloid progenitor differentiation toward neutrophil granulocytes
rationale: Members describe myeloid progenitor commitment and transcriptional/G-CSF-driven granulopoiesis to neutrophils, whereas confusables concern monocyte/macrophage/dendritic cell, eosinophil/mast cell or GM-CSF/M-CSF-driven differentiation.

qualifier: by autophagy and ESCRT-mediated multivesicular body sorting
name: Autophagy and ESCRT-mediated multivesicular body sorting
rationale: Members span selective autophagy, autophagosome/MVB-lysosome fusion and ESCRT-dependent MVB sorting, receptor downregulation and viral budding; confusables lack either the ESCRT/MVB arm (lysosome fusion, endosome size) or the autophagy arm (cytokinetic ESCRT) or are protein quality control.

qualifier: presynaptic active zone maintenance and postsynaptic receptor recycling
name: Presynaptic active zone maintenance and postsynaptic receptor recycling
rationale: Members cover presynaptic active-zone/cytoskeleton structure and vesicle clustering plus endosomal recycling and localization of postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptors, unlike confusables on Rab/ARF signaling, AMPA trafficking or clathrin-mediated vesicle endocytosis.

name: Antioxidant defense against reactive oxygen and nitrogen species
rationale: Members concern responses to peroxide and nitric oxide, ROS detoxification, redox homeostasis and HMOX1/BACH1/MTF1-driven protective gene expression, whereas confusables emphasise oxidative-stress-induced cell death, ferroptosis/hypoxia or ROS production.

name: NT-3/TrkC receptor signaling through RAS–MAPK cascades
rationale: Members are NTF3/NTRK3 signaling via RAS, FRS2/ARMS adaptors, ERK5 and RIT/RIN-p38 MAPK cascades, while confusables centre on NGF/TrkA signaling and CREB/STAT3 outputs.

qualifier: downstream of insulin/IGF1 receptor IRS signaling
name: Insulin/IGF1 receptor IRS signaling to PI3K/AKT activation
rationale: Members cover IRS/SHC/SOS events from insulin/IGF1 receptors leading to PI3K/AKT (AKT2) activation and glycogen synthesis, distinguished from confusables on negative insulin regulation, ALK/LTK or MET/EPO receptor signaling.

name: Amino acid catabolism and glyoxylate–glycine metabolism
rationale: Members are general amino acid/amide catabolism plus glycine synthesis and glyoxylate metabolism, which separates the theme from confusables specific to tyrosine, proline or threonine catabolism.

name: Pinocytic uptake and early endosome cargo routing
rationale: Members concern pinocytosis and onward routing of cargo from early endosomes to late or recycling endosomes and transcytosis, unlike confusables on macropinocytic protrusions, Golgi-endosome transport, receptor recycling or GLUT4 translocation.

name: Eye and inner ear development and hair-cell function
rationale: Members span camera-eye, lens, retina and ocular vasculature development together with inner ear morphogenesis, hair-cell stereocilia and auditory/vestibular sensation, whereas confusables cover photoreceptor/retinal neuron differentiation or cranial nerve and olfactory development.

name: Lipoprotein receptor internalization and degradation in cholesterol uptake
rationale: Members concern LDLR/VLDLR internalization, lysosomal receptor degradation and LXR-limited cholesterol import, separating the theme from SREBP/cholesterol synthesis, chylomicron/VLDL lipase clearance and generic receptor surface-localization confusables.

qualifier: sperm DNA condensation and protamine exchange
name: Sperm chromatin condensation and male germline genes
rationale: Members concern sperm DNA condensation, protamine-to-nucleosome replacement, crotonylation, spermatogonial division and Y-linked genes, distinct from confusables on piRNA silencing, meiosis or maternal-to-zygotic transition.

name: Chylomicron remodeling by lipoprotein and hepatic lipases
rationale: All members describe LPL/LIPC lipase assembly and chylomicron remodeling, distinct from confusables on lipoprotein clearance, chylomicron/VLDL assembly or LXR-driven lipid gene expression.

name: Endothelial differentiation, vessel morphogenesis and adherens junction regulation
rationale: Members cover endothelial fate, arterial/venous/lymphatic differentiation and vasculogenesis plus cadherin adherens-junction regulation, while confusables are BMP/SMAD-driven cardiac, outflow tract and coronary vascular development.

name: Mature B cell surface marker signatures
rationale: All members are B cell-enriched or naive/memory B cell surface signatures, lacking the plasma cell/immunoglobulin, germinal center/Tfh and memory-specific modules of the confusables.

qualifier: neural plate regionalization and axial mesoderm
name: Neural plate regionalization and axial mesoderm patterning
rationale: Members cover neural plate formation, border and neural crest specification, hindbrain/MHB segmentation, notochord, floor plate and axial mesoderm, unlike confusables on somitogenesis, Hox clusters, spinal cord patterning or convergent extension.

qualifier: CXCR4 and S1P receptor-driven, lymphoid organ context
name: CXCR4 and S1P receptor lymphocyte chemotaxis in lymphoid organs
rationale: Members involve CXCL12/CXCR4 and S1P receptor signaling, Rac activation and T/B cell chemotaxis with lymph node and marginal zone B cell development, while confusables emphasise mucosal lymphoid tissue, dendritic/myeloid chemokine responses or Cdc42/PLC signaling.

name: piRNA-mediated transposon silencing and oocyte cytoplasm organization
rationale: Members concern piRNA biogenesis and heterochromatin-based retroelement silencing together with oocyte construction, distinct from confusables on maternal-to-zygotic transition or sperm chromatin/male germline.

core: Negative regulation of inflammatory cytokine production
name: Suppression of TLR2/TLR4 signaling and proinflammatory cytokine production
rationale: All members negatively regulate LPS/TLR2/TLR4 signaling or IL-1beta, IL-6 and TNF production, unlike confusables centred on IL-10/IL-12, NF-kappaB/TNF signaling or T cell responses.
